CustomField.description: Links this Deliverable Line Item to its parent Deliverable. Each Deliverable Line Item represents a single unit of delivery under the parent Deliverable and is used for unit-level delivery tracking and rollups.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the Deliverable this line item belongs to. Deliverable Line Items are created to track delivery at the unit level when a Deliverable represents multiple units of work.
CustomField.label: Deliverable
